body.p: The hazel grouse was a big one. Like a black grouse, like a wood grouse. When he flew, he frightened God.[StN]: tin? God cut out its meat. He put a piece of it to the taimen's side [cheek]. He put it on the black grouse's breast, on the black grouse. The hazel grouse became small.
